intro.text: A number sign (#) is used with this entry because of evidence that autosomal recessive dilated cardiomyopathy-2A (CMD2A) is caused by mutation in the gene encoding cardiac troponin I (TNNI3; 191044) on chromosome 19q13.42.

checks.claim: Autosomal recessive dilated cardiomyopathy-2A (CMD2A) is caused by mutation in the TNNI3 gene, which encodes cardiac troponin I.
checks.evidence_quote: We identified a novel TNNI3 mutation in a family with recessive disease.
checks.explanation: Abstract links recessive dilated cardiomyopathy to TNNI3 (cardiac troponin I); CMD2A is nomenclature.

checks.claim: The TNNI3 gene is located on chromosome 19q13.42.
checks.evidence_quote: the sarcomeric gene for cardiac troponin I (TNNI3)
checks.explanation: Chromosomal location not stated in abstract but is standard nomenclature restating the gene.

paragraphs.text: Murphy et al. (2004) noted that idiopathic dilated cardiomyopathy is a common cause of heart failure. CMD2A is an autosomal recessive form of idiopathic dilated cardiomyopathy caused by mutation in the cardiac troponin I gene (TNNI3) (Murphy et al., 2004).

checks.claim: Idiopathic dilated cardiomyopathy is a common cause of heart failure.
checks.evidence_quote: Idiopathic dilated cardiomyopathy is a common cause of heart failure.

checks.claim: CMD2A is an autosomal recessive form of idiopathic dilated cardiomyopathy.
checks.evidence_quote: TNNI3 is the first recessive gene identified for this condition
checks.explanation: Recessive form of idiopathic dilated cardiomyopathy described.

checks.claim: CMD2A is caused by mutation in the cardiac troponin I gene (TNNI3).
checks.evidence_quote: We identified a novel TNNI3 mutation in a family with recessive disease.
checks.explanation: Mutation in TNNI3 underlies the recessive form.

paragraphs.text: Murphy et al. (2004) established autosomal recessive inheritance of CMD2A. They identified a TNNI3 mutation in a family with recessive disease.

checks.evidence_quote: We identified a novel TNNI3 mutation in a family with recessive disease.

checks.claim: Murphy et al. (2004) identified a TNNI3 mutation in a family with recessive dilated cardiomyopathy.
checks.evidence_quote: We identified a novel TNNI3 mutation in a family with recessive disease.

paragraphs.text: Carballo et al. (2009) noted that dilated cardiomyopathy is genetically heterogeneous and that inherited forms are usually transmitted as autosomal dominant traits. TNNI3 is a known hypertrophic cardiomyopathy disease gene, and Carballo et al. (2009) reported the first autosomal dominant dilated cardiomyopathy-causing mutations in TNNI3.

checks.evidence_quote: More than 30 loci have been identified, several of which encode sarcomeric proteins which can also be mutated to cause hypertrophic cardiomyopathy.
checks.explanation: The paper reports more than 30 DCM loci, which shows the disease is genetically heterogeneous.

checks.claim: Inherited forms of dilated cardiomyopathy are usually transmitted as autosomal dominant traits.
checks.evidence_quote: Idiopathic dilated cardiomyopathy (DCM) is inherited in approximately one third of cases, usually as an autosomal dominant trait.

checks.claim: TNNI3 is a known hypertrophic cardiomyopathy disease gene.
checks.evidence_quote: One contractile protein gene well known as a hypertrophic cardiomyopathy disease gene, but with no reported mutation in autosomal dominant DCM, is TNNI3 which encodes cardiac troponin I.

checks.claim: Carballo et al. (2009) reported the first autosomal dominant dilated cardiomyopathy-causing mutations in TNNI3.
checks.evidence_quote: These are the first reported autosomal dominant DCM-causing mutations in TNNI3

paragraphs.text: Murphy et al. (2004) studied a family with recessively inherited idiopathic dilated cardiomyopathy and identified a novel mutation in the TNNI3 gene. Functional studies showed impairment of troponin interactions that could lead to diminished myocardial contractility.

checks.claim: Murphy et al. (2004) studied a family with recessively inherited idiopathic dilated cardiomyopathy.
checks.evidence_quote: We identified a novel TNNI3 mutation in a family with recessive disease.
checks.explanation: Family with recessive idiopathic DCM studied.

checks.claim: Murphy et al. (2004) identified a novel TNNI3 mutation in a family with recessively inherited idiopathic dilated cardiomyopathy.
checks.evidence_quote: We identified a novel TNNI3 mutation in a family with recessive disease.

checks.claim: Functional studies of the novel TNNI3 mutation found in a family with recessive idiopathic dilated cardiomyopathy showed that it impaired troponin interactions.
checks.evidence_quote: Functional studies showed impairment of troponin interactions that could lead to diminished myocardial contractility.

checks.claim: The impaired troponin interactions caused by the novel TNNI3 mutation found in a family with recessive idiopathic dilated cardiomyopathy could lead to reduced contraction of the heart muscle (myocardial contractility).
checks.evidence_quote: Functional studies showed impairment of troponin interactions that could lead to diminished myocardial contractility.
